barRaise.topFinding: Both backup directories (data/backups/ and X:\.budget\backups\) hold zero snapshot files right now, on a 649-transaction ledger that has already lost real data once: three genuine bank charges the natural key at db.ts:120 cannot distinguish (two PayPal DGSCENE.COM charges and one Anthropic charge, each a legitimate same-day twin) remain permanently missing from the live ledger, unrecovered since first found 18 passes ago. Bulk-delete, merge-merchant, and Plaid-sync all still bypass the backup step entirely. The automation loop watching this project is itself unreliable in a way that compounds the risk: the work queue has not moved a single item across the whole 667-row cross-project file in 5 days, a finding closed 2026-07-25 was silently re-opened the same day and is still open, and the project-canonical-audit skill that runs against this repo nightly has been found corrupted in one or the other of its two registered copies on two consecutive bar-raise passes. On the up side, the CI/cost story genuinely improved: the portfolio-wide routine consolidation on 2026-07-30 cut Budget's Claude-automation spend from a $3.41/day floor to about $1.15/day, in line with peer projects, and the dashboard-writer 0/0/0 bug from the last report is fixed. But this is a finished, code-frozen tool that has not had a real user write since 2026-05-22, still burns a full weekly review cycle, and that cycle just found a data loss it cannot currently recover from if it happens again.
